objective: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

description: I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.
Please, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Refuge. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.
I am feeling a little out of it, so if I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...
progress: I've been so worried about Ringo...
completion: Ringo's not in the best shape, <name>, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!
